C1_hero.h1: MAGLUMI CLIA test menu — 278 parameters from Snibe
C1_hero.lead: The MAGLUMI CLIA test menu is Snibe's list of parameters for chemiluminescence immunoassay testing. According to Snibe, the menu covers 278 parameters across 22 groups; assay names are reproduced verbatim from the manufacturer. Ask a LabWell manager about the availability of individual tests in Ukraine.
